verdict.rationale: Anytype's block-based editor is documented with headings (including collapsible toggled headings), inline LaTeX, and URL bookmarks with preview metadata. A co-founder confirms simple tables, and users describe the app as polished and smooth. The evidence covers only part of the story, though. missing for 10: evidence of callout blocks, code blocks, embedded media (video/audio/images inline), keyboard-driven editing (slash commands/shortcuts), and independent hands-on corroboration of editor speed.
